clara (Docs): opening a tiny PR to make the Optimize Toolkit section clearer: batching vs kv-prefetch for short prompts. found a dead link and a vague example.
jon (Eng): good. please include a short py + go example with explicit numbers (prefetch_window=32) and call out the short-prefix cutoff.
clara (Docs): draft py snippet: `requests = [{"prompt": p, "max_tokens":24} for p in prompts]; client.batch_generate(requests, prefetch_window=32, enable_kv_prefetch=True)`
rui (ML): add quant guidance: "if prefix caching is important, prefer 8-bit or mixed precision; test any 4-bit profile with the eval harness." include rationale about cache fidelity.
sam (DevEx): add a one-line debug tip: enable client debug and grep for `prefetch_applied=true` or `prefetch_skipped=short_prefix`. also include tiny go snippet for parity.
mina (QA): i can run a small perf toggle script if you add it to examples/optkit/perf; i'll paste p50/p95 and a short note for the changelog.
linkbot: link-check queued once PR is opened.
clara (Docs): plan: docs PR to fix link + add snippets + quant note + debug tip, examples PR with perf script. tagging jon/rui/sam/mina for reviews. will avoid words like "aggressive" and use explicit thresholds.
jon (Eng): ack. also mention memory tradeoffs and that runtime may skip prefetch for prefixes <8 tokens to avoid overhead.
clara (Docs): thanks all, i'll open PRs in ~30m and ping reviewers. :sparkles:
